findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data on the page
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://example.com/']). Zero <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks found.

suggested_action.summary: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Organization on every page at minimum; Product/Article/LocalBusiness/FAQPage where relevant) so assistants can extract facts with certainty instead of inferring them from prose.

findings.title: No discoverable XML sitemap
findings.evidence: /sitemap.xml returned status 404 and robots.txt has no Sitemap: line.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap (or sitemap index) covering canonical pages and reference it in robots.txt so crawlers can find and prioritize content efficiently.
Improve TTFB (caching, CDN, server-side rendering) — slow responses cause crawlers and on-the-fly AI fetchers to time out or deprioritize the page.

findings.title: Thin visible text in raw HTML
findings.evidence: Only ~21 words of visible text found in HTML response (rendered with Playwright browser).

suggested_action.summary: Verify key facts (what the brand does, product details, pricing) are present as plain server-rendered text, not just implied by images or loaded asynchronously.

findings.title: No Organization/LocalBusiness entity markup to anchor identity
findings.evidence: No schema.org Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD block found.

suggested_action.summary: Add an Organization JSON-LD block with name, url, logo, and sameAs — without it there is no machine-readable anchor for 'who this brand is' at all.
Add a persistent navigation region with links to key sections (product, pricing, about, contact) so visitors — and agents browsing on a user's behalf — can orient and go deeper instead of leaving.

findings.title: No internal links found on homepage
findings.evidence: Zero same-domain links found on the homepage.

suggested_action.summary: Link to key internal pages from the homepage so visitors have somewhere to go next.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://example.com/']). No <meta name="description"> content found.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise (~150-160 char) meta description stating what the page/brand offers — assistants and search snippets draw on this.
Add a robots.txt that explicitly allows crawling and points to the sitemap; its absence isn't fatal but removes a cheap, explicit signal of intent.

findings.title: No canonical link tag
findings.evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> found on the homepage.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referencing canonical tag on every indexable page to consolidate ranking signals and avoid duplicate-content ambiguity.

findings.title: Corroboration research not performed for this run
findings.evidence: No --search-results input was supplied, so cross-source agreement for this brand's key claims was not evaluated.

suggested_action.summary: Have the calling agent web-search 3-5 of the page's key factual claims (founding date, HQ, pricing, leadership) and re-run this check with --search-results to score corroboration.

findings.title: Incomplete Open Graph tags
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://example.com/']). og:title present=False, og:description present=False.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image so link previews and summarization tools have a clean, authoritative source to quote.

findings.title: No contact phone or hours found in plain text
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://example.com/']). No phone-number or opening-hours pattern detected in visible text.

suggested_action.summary: If applicable to this business, state phone/hours as plain text and in LocalBusiness JSON-LD — assistants answering 'is X open now / what's their number' need this in extractable form.

Consider publishing an llms.txt at the site root — a short, plain-text index of the site's key pages and facts written specifically for AI agents. It's not yet a universal standard, but costs little to add and gives assistants a direct, curated entry point instead of relying on inference.

findings.title: Consider a machine-readable dateModified in JSON-LD
findings.evidence: A freshness signal was found (Last-Modified HTTP header, dated 2026-09-02), but it lives in a meta tag/visible text/HTTP header rather than structured data.

suggested_action.summary: In addition to what's already present, add 'dateModified' (and 'datePublished') to the page's Article/WebPage JSON-LD block — assistants that parse structured data directly get an unambiguous, typed timestamp instead of having to interpret text.

findings.title: No <main> landmark element
findings.evidence: 1/1 pages checked show this issue (examples: ['https://example.com/']). No <main> tag found; the primary-content region isn't explicitly marked.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap the core content in a <main> element (even if boilerplate ratio is currently fine) — it's a cheap, unambiguous signal for extractors and accessibility tools to weight the right region as the page's substance, and protects against boilerplate creeping in as the page grows.
